author: regression-suite
note: 60004 Heightened Hearing: when attached enemy attacks, discard this card, that enemy gets -3 ATK for that attack. Rhino stage 3 (ATK 4) because stage 1's ATK 2 cannot show a -3 at all. Puzzle.Boost(c10) is what makes him attack -- it calls villain.DoActivate, so no villain phase is needed; Armored Rhino Suit is the boost card precisely because it has no Boost key, hence zero boost icons and a deterministic ATK. The basic defense is DECLINED, so no DEF is subtracted and the arithmetic is exactly 4 - 3 = 1: hero 10 - 1 = 9. That pins the modifier at -3 and nothing else -- a control with no upgrade attached takes the full 4 and lands on 6, and a -2 would land on 8. Frame budget matters here more than anywhere else in the suite: at 18 frames this board still reads 10 because the damage has not been applied yet, which looks like a clean prevent and is really a half-resolved read. Two bugs this pins, both of which left the card cycling back into the Sense deck with the hero taking full damage and no error anywhere: pairing SetLabel('defense') with WhenUnitWouldAttackUnit (SpecialDefense has no branch for that message and hits assert False), and omitting NoOutOfPlayLimit (the Discard cost removes the card from play before CheckNotOutOfPlay runs).
